content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

Every German citizen has a right to education. Quality at universities has its price, which is why students also ought to be involved in this cost factor. But education must not be a question of money in a wealthy society such as Germany. Therefore universities should not charge tuition fees in Germany.
What is the relation between "Every German citizen has a right to education." and "Therefore universities should not charge tuition fees in Germany." from the above essay? Choose from following options  1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
